name: tau2-retail-two-visit-01
allocation: 77 independent customers × two counterfactual prior orders × three current openings × five memory arms, one independent session per cell. Hash order within each stage before outcomes. Keep each customer's profile order and all six cases intact. A prespecified 26-customer continuation includes 18/54 customers whose pair includes the first profile order and 8/23 whose pair does not. An all-customer continuation is a separately costed option to select before observations.
source: 154 new ordinary read-only source tasks in a fresh retail environment each. Use every normal completed source, including score zero. Four independent optional writers per public worker transcript, original instructions, no evaluation feedback. Keep successful voluntary empties. Report missing sources or technical writer failures and never replace them with empty notes. Controls remain eligible on their own.
decision: Freeze the public opening, authentication and profile reads. Register a fresh native DB and replay the public history. Put the source's sealed items in the agent's assigned interface only. Freeze the first customer-facing reply or batch containing a business tool. Allow up to four worker calls including private retrieval to reach this point. Preserve the raw mixed batch, memory exposures and first action before dispatch. No simulator turn occurs before this measurement.
primary: Within previous_only, estimate the automatic-versus-empty preload difference in a single get_order_details call for the intended order as the first business decision. Include both histories regardless of what the writer kept. Pair by exact case and summarize each customer equally. Report paired coverage, customer gains/ties/losses and the raw denominators.
secondary: Prespecify the difference in the preload contrast between later and first profile targets, with customer clustering. Report stratified numerators, customers and uncertainty. The profile determines order position. Estimate query versus empty_query in previous_only, actual list/title/body exposure, pure baseline, current-same and current-other separately. For a full consultation measure requests to identify the order, wrong-order proposals and corrected proposals, explicit consent before each cancellation, correct final DB and expense. A legitimate clarification can achieve full success.
grading: Keep native DB reward, ordered tool trace and transcript-based confirmation as distinct outcomes. A consent-qualified completion needs a normally terminated correct DB, explicit current consent to the intended order and stated cancellation reason before the mutation, and no other order cancelled. Blind manual coding to the arm, memory and source. Preserve linked evidence turns and permit unresolved labels. Report missing, incomplete and unreviewed outcomes explicitly.
analysis: Analyze every allocated cell. Report technical failures separately, including paired coverage and the binary outcome bounds for missing cases. Average the available paired cases per customer and then average customers equally. Report gains, ties, losses, the two-sided exact sign test and a descriptive percentile interval from 10,000 customer resamples with seed 20261122. For the prespecified later-minus-first interaction average per-customer paired contrasts within each stratum, then resample the same customers jointly. Query use includes separate counts for requested list/get, returned title/body and actual input exposure before the first business decision. The position interaction and secondary outcomes are descriptive. In the full sessions count order-identification questions, wrong order proposals, later correct proposals, official DB reward and consent-qualified completion. Reviewers use public speech and business actions, record proposal/order/reason, and link explicit current approval, refusal or withdrawal to the proposal before cancellation.
billing: No funds are authorized by this draft. Freeze stage scope, permitted continuation customers, model identities, cache-inclusive rates, maximum spend and request limits before any live submission. Keep one cost ledger across stages, reserve each request before sending, retain the maximum for unpriced submissions, and never re-send an attempted decision.
